weaknesses.reading: the registered kill rule cannot tell a correct rule from a worthless one. A FAILED_VARIANT written on 2026-12-24 under it carries about two percentage points of information and must be read as CANNOT_DISTINGUISH, not as a rejection. The Brier falsifier has the same defect: with p between 0.506 and 0.510, it fires whenever fewer than half of four names beat SPY.
